title: Hamiltonian-Type Spectral Functionals for Time-Dependent Perturbed Hodge--de Rham Operators
summary: Let $g_t$ be a smooth family of Riemannian metrics on an oriented manifold of even dimension $n\geq4$, and let $D_t=d+δ_{g_t}+Ψ_t$ on the fixed exterior bundle, with $Ψ_t$ self-adjoint. We evaluate a scalar-weighted residue functional obtained from the operator expression in Hawkins' Hamiltonian action using the coefficient derivative $\partial_tD_t$. The velocity contribution depends only on $\partial_tg_t$.
